from __future__ import annotations

import bisect
import heapq


class CandidateQueryEngine:
    """Dict + sorted-key-list implementation for fast range queries via bisect."""

    def __init__(self, items: dict[int, int] | None = None):
        self._data: dict[int, int] = {}
        if items:
            self._data.update(items)
        self._keys: list[int] = sorted(self._data)

    def put(self, key: int, value: int) -> None:
        k = int(key)
        v = int(value)
        if k not in self._data:
            bisect.insort(self._keys, k)
        self._data[k] = v

    def delete(self, key: int) -> None:
        k = int(key)
        if k in self._data:
            del self._data[k]
            idx = bisect.bisect_left(self._keys, k)
            if idx < len(self._keys) and self._keys[idx] == k:
                self._keys.pop(idx)

    def get(self, key: int) -> int | None:
        return self._data.get(int(key))

    def range_sum(self, lo: int, hi: int) -> int:
        lo = int(lo)
        hi = int(hi)
        if lo > hi:
            return 0
        keys = self._keys
        data = self._data
        left = bisect.bisect_left(keys, lo)
        right = bisect.bisect_right(keys, hi)
        total = 0
        for i in range(left, right):
            total += data[keys[i]]
        return total

    def aggregate_count(self, lo: int, hi: int) -> int:
        lo = int(lo)
        hi = int(hi)
        if lo > hi:
            return 0
        left = bisect.bisect_left(self._keys, lo)
        right = bisect.bisect_right(self._keys, hi)
        return right - left

    def top_k(self, lo: int, hi: int, k: int) -> list[tuple[int, int]]:
        lo = int(lo)
        hi = int(hi)
        k = int(k)
        if lo > hi or k <= 0:
            return []
        keys = self._keys
        data = self._data
        left = bisect.bisect_left(keys, lo)
        right = bisect.bisect_right(keys, hi)
        count = right - left
        if count == 0:
            return []
        if k >= count:
            rows = [(keys[i], data[keys[i]]) for i in range(left, right)]
            rows.sort(key=lambda item: (-item[1], item[0]))
            return rows
        result = heapq.nsmallest(k, range(left, right),
                                  key=lambda i: (-data[keys[i]], keys[i]))
        return [(keys[i], data[keys[i]]) for i in result]

from __future__ import annotations

import bisect
import heapq


class CandidateQueryEngine:
    """Dict + sorted-keys + Fenwick trees for O(log K) range_sum and aggregate_count."""

    __slots__ = ('_data', '_keys', '_stree', '_ctree', '_N')

    def __init__(self, items: dict[int, int] | None = None):
        N = 50002
        self._N = N
        st = [0] * (N + 1)
        ct = [0] * (N + 1)
        self._stree = st
        self._ctree = ct

        if items:
            self._data: dict[int, int] = {int(k): int(v) for k, v in items.items()}
            self._keys: list[int] = sorted(self._data)
            for k, v in self._data.items():
                i = k + 1
                while i <= N:
                    st[i] += v
                    ct[i] += 1
                    i += i & (-i)
        else:
            self._data = {}
            self._keys = []

    def put(self, key: int, value: int) -> None:
        key = int(key)
        value = int(value)
        data = self._data
        N = self._N
        i = key + 1
        if key in data:
            delta = value - data[key]
            data[key] = value
            st = self._stree
            while i <= N:
                st[i] += delta
                i += i & (-i)
        else:
            data[key] = value
            bisect.insort(self._keys, key)
            st = self._stree
            ct = self._ctree
            j = i
            while i <= N:
                st[i] += value
                i += i & (-i)
            while j <= N:
                ct[j] += 1
                j += j & (-j)

    def delete(self, key: int) -> None:
        key = int(key)
        data = self._data
        if key in data:
            v = data.pop(key)
            idx = bisect.bisect_left(self._keys, key)
            self._keys.pop(idx)
            N = self._N
            i = key + 1
            st = self._stree
            ct = self._ctree
            j = i
            while i <= N:
                st[i] -= v
                i += i & (-i)
            while j <= N:
                ct[j] -= 1
                j += j & (-j)

    def get(self, key: int) -> int | None:
        return self._data.get(int(key))

    def range_sum(self, lo: int, hi: int) -> int:
        lo = int(lo)
        hi = int(hi)
        if lo > hi:
            return 0
        st = self._stree
        s = 0
        i = hi + 1
        while i > 0:
            s += st[i]
            i -= i & (-i)
        i = lo
        while i > 0:
            s -= st[i]
            i -= i & (-i)
        return s

    def aggregate_count(self, lo: int, hi: int) -> int:
        lo = int(lo)
        hi = int(hi)
        if lo > hi:
            return 0
        ct = self._ctree
        s = 0
        i = hi + 1
        while i > 0:
            s += ct[i]
            i -= i & (-i)
        i = lo
        while i > 0:
            s -= ct[i]
            i -= i & (-i)
        return s

    def top_k(self, lo: int, hi: int, k: int) -> list[tuple[int, int]]:
        lo = int(lo)
        hi = int(hi)
        k = int(k)
        if lo > hi or k <= 0:
            return []
        keys = self._keys
        left = bisect.bisect_left(keys, lo)
        right = bisect.bisect_right(keys, hi)
        n = right - left
        if n == 0:
            return []
        data = self._data
        if k >= n:
            rows = [(keys[i], data[keys[i]]) for i in range(left, right)]
            rows.sort(key=lambda item: (-item[1], item[0]))
            return rows
        return heapq.nsmallest(
            k,
            ((keys[i], data[keys[i]]) for i in range(left, right)),
            key=lambda item: (-item[1], item[0]),
        )

from __future__ import annotations

import bisect
import heapq


class CandidateQueryEngine:
    """Fenwick-tree (BIT) backed implementation for O(log n) range aggregates."""

    __slots__ = ('_data', '_keys', '_sum_bit', '_cnt_bit', '_n')

    def __init__(self, items: dict[int, int] | None = None):
        self._n = 50001
        n = self._n
        self._data: dict[int, int] = {}
        self._keys: list[int] = []
        self._sum_bit = [0] * (n + 1)
        self._cnt_bit = [0] * (n + 1)
        if items:
            self._data = {int(k): int(v) for k, v in items.items()}
            self._keys = sorted(self._data)
            sum_bit = self._sum_bit
            cnt_bit = self._cnt_bit
            for k, v in self._data.items():
                j = k + 1
                while j <= n:
                    sum_bit[j] += v
                    cnt_bit[j] += 1
                    j += j & (-j)

    def put(self, key: int, value: int) -> None:
        data = self._data
        sum_bit = self._sum_bit
        n = self._n
        if key in data:
            delta = value - data[key]
            data[key] = value
            if delta:
                j = key + 1
                while j <= n:
                    sum_bit[j] += delta
                    j += j & (-j)
        else:
            data[key] = value
            bisect.insort(self._keys, key)
            cnt_bit = self._cnt_bit
            j = key + 1
            while j <= n:
                sum_bit[j] += value
                cnt_bit[j] += 1
                j += j & (-j)

    def delete(self, key: int) -> None:
        data = self._data
        if key in data:
            val = data.pop(key)
            idx = bisect.bisect_left(self._keys, key)
            self._keys.pop(idx)
            sum_bit = self._sum_bit
            cnt_bit = self._cnt_bit
            n = self._n
            j = key + 1
            while j <= n:
                sum_bit[j] -= val
                cnt_bit[j] -= 1
                j += j & (-j)

    def get(self, key: int) -> int | None:
        return self._data.get(key)

    def range_sum(self, lo: int, hi: int) -> int:
        if lo > hi:
            return 0
        sum_bit = self._sum_bit
        s = 0
        j = hi + 1
        while j > 0:
            s += sum_bit[j]
            j -= j & (-j)
        if lo > 0:
            j = lo
            while j > 0:
                s -= sum_bit[j]
                j -= j & (-j)
        return s

    def aggregate_count(self, lo: int, hi: int) -> int:
        if lo > hi:
            return 0
        cnt_bit = self._cnt_bit
        s = 0
        j = hi + 1
        while j > 0:
            s += cnt_bit[j]
            j -= j & (-j)
        if lo > 0:
            j = lo
            while j > 0:
                s -= cnt_bit[j]
                j -= j & (-j)
        return s

    def top_k(self, lo: int, hi: int, k: int) -> list[tuple[int, int]]:
        if lo > hi or k <= 0:
            return []
        left = bisect.bisect_left(self._keys, lo)
        right = bisect.bisect_right(self._keys, hi)
        if left >= right:
            return []
        data = self._data
        keys = self._keys
        n = right - left
        rows = [(keys[i], data[keys[i]]) for i in range(left, right)]
        if k >= n:
            rows.sort(key=lambda item: (-item[1], item[0]))
            return rows
        return heapq.nsmallest(k, rows, key=lambda item: (-item[1], item[0]))
